scripts.infra:config: npm run infra:prepare && docker compose -f infra/compose.yaml config --quiet
scripts.infra:up: npm run infra:prepare && docker compose -f infra/compose.yaml up -d --wait
scripts.server:run: npm run infra:prepare && SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE=local ./server/mvnw -f server/pom.xml spring-boot:run -Dspring-boot.run.workingDirectory=..
scripts.check: npm run infra:config && ./scripts/check-local-baseline.sh && ./infra/staging/scripts/deployment-gate-test.sh && npm run openapi:lint && npm run server:verify && npm run client:lint && npm run client:test && npm run client:build
